recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, multi-layered collage featuring grainy black-and-white photography overlaid with torn paper elements, vibrant watercolor-style washes, and bold, distressed typography that mimics a DIY zine or street-art aesthetic.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast monochrome figures against a textured, desaturated background.
Bold, black display type anchored on a central, brightly colored rectangular paper scrap.
Secondary sans-serif text placed on a dark, horizontal strip at the bottom third.
Rough, torn edges and overlapping paper layers creating physical depth.
coreInvariants: Heavy halftone and photocopy grain across all photographic elements.
A palette dominated by black, white, and grey with sharp accents of magenta and violet.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three male figures in suits occupy the upper half, appearing as a grainy, desaturated focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: A large, central rectangular scrap of paper containing the primary display text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the figures at the top, down to the large central text, finishing on the smaller text strip at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with textures, overlapping images, and paper scraps.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black and white photocopy tones provide the structural foundation.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Desaturated grey and off-white paper textures.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant magenta and violet watercolor washes applied to the central text block.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast (black vs. white) paired with localized high-saturation color pops.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to 3 primary hues plus monochrome

letterConstructionRules: Tight kerning with occasional overlapping characters
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 't' and 'h' in the top line are significantly smaller than the main uppercase letters below.
Apostrophe styled as a thick, vertical rectangular notch.

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed on a dark horizontal strip

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavyweight display sans-serif paired with a cleaner, medium-weight geometric sans-serif for legibility.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and blocky structure.
Offers a classic grotesque feel that fits the zine aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a mixed-media collage with three men in suits at the top in grainy black and white photocopy style. The background should be a messy mix of torn paper, halftone newsprint, and a central rectangular scrap with magenta and violet watercolor washes. Add a dark horizontal strip at the bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a heavy, distressed black sans-serif font to the central watercolor scrap. Add a secondary all-caps bold sans-serif in light grey on the bottom dark strip. Ensure all text has a slight ink-bleed or photocopy noise effect.

verificationChecks: Is the central text block the primary visual anchor?
Does the imagery have a consistent high-grain photocopy texture?
Are the magenta and violet accents localized to the text area?
Are the paper edges visibly torn and layered?

mustRedesign: Any specific faces or recognizable individuals
postGenerationChecks: Check for visible paper seams and overlaps.
Ensure text looks printed/stamped rather than digitally placed.
Verify the halftone pattern is visible in the photographic areas.
Confirm the color palette is restricted to the specified accents.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Subject: Grainy B&W Photography] + [Texture: Torn Paper & Halftone] + [Accent: Watercolor Wash] + [Typography: Distressed Heavy Sans-Serif] for a DIY punk-inspired collage.
